539-2034-3821-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2034-3821-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3430-6256-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-6256-7014.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

586-3899-5258-5618-6580.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

549-5411-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5411-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Need for Speed.

153-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
153-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Jolrael
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2043-7295-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-7295-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

240-1322-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3200-4986-6797.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2173-3652-4779-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4336-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5411-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5411-5686.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5411-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4050-5187-5544-6822.description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Lyla triggers.

2060-4929-5652-6774.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
2060-4929-5652-6774.notes: Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

338-3197-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-6752.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-5147-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

698-1954-3152.easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
698-1954-3152.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained 3 or more life this turn.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {W}.
698-1954-3152.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {3} less.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve Change of Heart.
Repeat from step 2.

465-618-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

372-1309-3306.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-1309-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5402.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5402.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Captain Storm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

671-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
671-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Daxos, Blessed by the Sun triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

933-1530-2928-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
933-1530-2928-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

215-1526-1909-4852.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-1909-4852.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Elvish Mystic to your hand from the battlefield, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Symbiote from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Repeat.

15-1722-4050-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
15-1722-4050-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Laid to Rest triggers, drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, paying {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

3469-3789-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-3789-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-3789-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
